quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Dinosaur!
quests.question: d
quests.hint: It sits between C and E in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found d. It sits between C and E in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Some dinosaurs were as small as a chicken!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Earth!
quests.question: e
quests.hint: It comes right before F.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found e. It comes right before F.
quests.funFact: Earth is the only planet in our solar system not named after a god!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Firetruck!
quests.question: f
quests.hint: It sits between E and G in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found f. It sits between E and G in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Early firetrucks were actually pulled by horses, not engines!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Gorilla!
quests.question: G
quests.hint: It sits between F and H in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found G. It sits between F and H in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Gorillas can learn sign language and communicate with humans!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Horse!
quests.question: H
quests.hint: It comes right before I.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found H. It comes right before I.
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing up and lying down!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Igloo!
quests.question: I
quests.hint: It sits between H and J in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found I. It sits between H and J in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: An igloo can be 40 degrees warmer inside than outside, just from body heat!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Jellyfish!
quests.question: j
quests.hint: It sits between I and K in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found j. It sits between I and K in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Jellyfish don't have brains, hearts, or bones, and are 95% water!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Kangaroo!
quests.question: k
quests.hint: It comes right before L.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found k. It comes right before L.
quests.funFact: Kangaroos use their strong tails for balance, so if you lift their tail, they can't hop!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Lemon!
quests.question: l
quests.hint: It sits between K and M in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found l. It sits between K and M in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Lemons contain more sugar than strawberries!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Moon!
quests.question: M
quests.hint: It sits between L and N in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found M. It sits between L and N in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth by about an inch every year!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Nose!
quests.question: N
quests.hint: It comes right before O.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found N. It comes right before O.
quests.funFact: Your nose can remember up to 50,000 different scents!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Octopus!
quests.question: O
quests.hint: It sits between N and P in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found O. It sits between N and P in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Pizza!
quests.question: p
quests.hint: It sits between O and Q in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found p. It sits between O and Q in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: The first pizza was created in Naples, Italy, in the 1800s!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Quail!
quests.question: q
quests.hint: It comes right before R.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found q. It comes right before R.
quests.funFact: Quails love to take 'dust baths' to keep their feathers clean!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Rainbow!
quests.question: r
quests.hint: It sits between Q and S in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found r. It sits between Q and S in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: You can only see a rainbow if the sun is completely behind you!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Snake!
quests.question: S
quests.hint: It sits between R and T in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found S. It sits between R and T in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Snakes can't blink because they don't have eyelids!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Train!
quests.question: T
quests.hint: It comes right before U.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found T. It comes right before U.
quests.funFact: The fastest train in the world can travel over 280 miles per hour!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word UFO!
quests.question: U
quests.hint: It sits between T and V in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found U. It sits between T and V in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: The term UFO was coined by the US Air Force in 1952!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Violin!
quests.question: v
quests.hint: It sits between U and W in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found v. It sits between U and W in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Playing the violin burns about 170 calories an hour!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Wolf!
quests.question: w
quests.hint: It comes right before X.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found w. It comes right before X.
quests.funFact: Wolves have webbed toes to help them swim and walk on snow easily!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Xenops!
quests.question: x
quests.hint: It sits between W and Y in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found x. It sits between W and Y in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: The xenops is a rainforest bird that loves to hang upside down while eating!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Yarn!
quests.question: Y
quests.hint: It sits between X and Z in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found Y. It sits between X and Z in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: A single ball of yarn can contain over 200 yards of wool!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Zipper!
quests.question: Z
quests.hint: Think about the letter that starts Zipper.
quests.explanation: Great eye! That's Z, just like in Zipper. 🤐
quests.funFact: The first zippers were used only for boots and tobacco pouches!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Alligator!
quests.question: A
quests.hint: It's the very first letter of the alphabet!
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found A. It's the very first letter of the alphabet!
quests.funFact: Alligators can go through 3,000 teeth in their lifetime!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Butterfly!
quests.question: b
quests.hint: It sits between A and C in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found b. It sits between A and C in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: Butterflies taste with their feet instead of their mouths!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Castle!
quests.question: c
quests.hint: It comes right before D.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found c. It comes right before D.
quests.funFact: The oldest inhabited castle in the world is Windsor Castle in England!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Drum!
quests.question: d
quests.hint: Think about the letter that starts Drum.
quests.explanation: Great eye! That's d, just like in Drum. 🥁
quests.funFact: Drums are the world's oldest and most common musical instruments!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Egg!
quests.question: E
quests.hint: It sits between D and F in the alphabet.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found E. It sits between D and F in the alphabet.
quests.funFact: The color of a hen's earlobe can tell you what color egg she will lay!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Flower!
quests.question: F
quests.hint: It comes right before G.
quests.explanation: Nicely done! You found F. It comes right before G.
quests.funFact: Sunflowers track the sun across the sky during the day!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Ghost!
quests.question: G
quests.hint: Think about the letter that starts Ghost.
quests.explanation: Great eye! That's G, just like in Ghost. 👻
quests.funFact: In old stories, ghosts were just a way to explain the wind rattling old houses!
